    Meet the three towns +

    Grove

    Small maps · inexpensive early armies, fast recruitment, and low resource costs.

    Pavilion

    Medium to large maps · caravans, hero training, and a balanced midgame army.

    Cathedral

    Large maps and long campaigns · costly investment, lasting income, and powerful elite troops.

    Choose these factions in a new game or random map. Fixed original campaigns keep their authored towns; campaigns must support the added factions. Details & credits

    Earn +3 Authority per town each day, plus +5 for each Capitol. Visit a town with a hero and click its fort, citadel or castle to issue a decree. Start a new game with this enabled; keep it enabled for those saves.

    The Royal Council +

    Spend Authority on 12 political actions: treasury and supplies, kingdom buffs, or sanctions weakening armies that fight your visiting hero. Each town issues one decree per week. Seven-day buffs of the same kind do not stack.

    Authority is part of the game save. See your balance and income by right-clicking the resource bar, or open Kingdom Overview. It uses the original royal treasury artwork and can be traded at the normal marketplace.

    All edicts, costs & rules

    Single player and local hot-seat. Choose a mode in the game menu.

      How does another computer work?+
      Open this same website and sign in. Your private game library downloads automatically; no game folder needs to be selected on that computer.
      Save in the game, then quit or use Return & sync. Keep the tab open until the launcher confirms Synced to cloud. Sign in on the other computer to continue from that upload.
      On a shared computer, keep the cleanup option checked and use Sign out when you finish. Signing out syncs first, then clears this device’s downloaded game files and local saves.
      
            
      What needs one-time setup?+
      Upload the complete site ZIP to Cloudflare Pages, then bind a free D1 database as DB and redeploy. Open the website, create your account, and select your own installed Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death folder on the upload screen.
      Your browser compresses and encrypts your upload. Your account stores it privately in the free database. Signing in on another computer downloads it automatically. The commercial game files are not included in this download. The HD Edition is not compatible.
      VCMI 1.7.5 supplies the browser engine. Scenarios, campaigns, random maps and local hot-seat use your installed game content. Original graphics are preserved; videos, Horn of the Abyss and online multiplayer are not included.
